static_traits.name: Gu Rui
static_traits.occupation: Aspires to become a fashion designer
static_traits.educational_background: Studies at a well-known design school in New York
static_traits.social_status: Lacking strong Social support in New York; relationships with design-school peers strained by Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; no past psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking, cooperative expression, able to identify and describe emotions and thoughts; tending toward self-reproach and frequent 'should' statements; emotional tone of Anxiety coexisting with hope

basic_info.main_problem: Since never being admitted to the favored prestigious design school, has been struggling with inferiority and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent sense of inferiority from being rejected significantly affects her passion for fashion design, and she hopes to deal with these issues through counseling.
growth_experiences: Six months ago, the client applied to a highly prestigious design school and was not admitted. Receiving the rejection letter was very stressful, producing thoughts like 'I should work harder, I should be more talented by now'. Since then persistent inferiority and Self-doubt appeared: Decreased drive, negative emotions and negation triggered when creating designs or visiting fashion stores for inspiration; often comparing self with masters like Alexander McQueen and Coco Chanel; trying to fight Self-doubt through harder work and setting unrealistically high standards but with poor results. The event led to Academic performance affected, Relationship tension with classmates, Sleep disturbance and Self-care declining; and lacking support from close family and friends in New York.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I am recognized by a prestigious school/authority

special_situations.event: Receiving a rejection letter from a renowned design school
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been admitted to a prestigious school, it proves I am not hardworking/talented enough, not worthy of fashion design
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately forcing oneself to 'work harder', setting unrealistic goals and repeatedly ruminating on failure causes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should work harder, I should be more talented; maybe I will never become a designer

special_situations.event: When creating designs and polishing the work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work is not perfect, it means I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-polishing and delaying submission, repeatedly negating one's drafts to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This draft is not good enough; if not perfect it will be negated

special_situations.event: Visits fashion stores for inspiration or sees excellent works/masterpieces
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others' work is better than mine, it proves I have no talent and do not deserve success
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing with top designers and belittling one's strengths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all stronger than me; I do not deserve to be a designer

special_situations.event: Communicating with classmates / peers from the design school or receiving peer feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, others will look down on me and relationships will worsen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids deep communication or over-explains as self-defense
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by authorities and peers, to have one's talent and unique style seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing rejection and negation, experiencing strong shame and failure feelings
defense_goal: Uses extremely high standards and self-blame to avoid failing again and shame
Reduces the risk of being evaluated by avoiding creating/communicating

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure/a Student needing to prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh reviewers and hard-to-satisfy authorities (prestigious schools, the industry)

object_relations.self_representation: A learner looking up and longing to be seen
object_relations.object_representation: Perfect and unattainable models of success (top designers)

manifestations: Lacking strong Social support in New York, family and close friends not nearby
Tense relationships with design peers due to Self-doubt
Passion for fashion design damaged after being rejected
Reduced creative motivation, avoiding inspiration gathering
outcomes: Confusion and loss about the career path

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently judges oneself with 'I should work harder / be more talented'
Takes admission to a prestigious school as the only or main standard of self-worth
Demands of oneself by the standards of top masters, ignores one's own stage-wise progress

exception_events.target_problem: When creating designs or visiting fashion stores for inspiration, the client usually develops strong inferiority and Self-doubt, reducing investment and wanting to give up.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Won awards in several local design competitions and received positive professor feedback multiple times; in those moments feeling proud and confident, able to recognize a unique style, different from usual Self-denial.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different support and evaluation (judges' and professors' positive feedback); different context (work fitting the unique style); different actions (focusing more on the work itself rather than comparing with masters), hence Self-doubt markedly reduced with positive results.

positive_force: Has won an award in a local design competition, with abilities and works that can be recognized
The professor giving continuous positive feedback
Having a recognized unique design style
Able to proactively seek help (chooses to enter counseling)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing, mind reading, and 'should' statements clearly present
Excessively binding self-worth to prestigious schools'/authorities' recognition and comparison with master-level figures
Setting unrealistic standards, frustration and exhaustion after overexertion
Weak social support system, lacking emotional buffering
Sleep disturbance and Self-care declining, further weakening motivation and executive function

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent Self-denial and comparing with top designers
antecedent: When visiting fashion stores for inspiration and seeing excellent works
target_behavior.core_reason: The rejection event activated the 'I am not good enough/lacking talent' core belief, with catastrophizing and all-or-nothing thinking
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid failing again and shame by belittling oneself and raising the threshold (short-term emotional control)
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation, reduced work investment, Interpersonal tension and Low mood

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding creation and inspiration gathering (Insufficient motivation, procrastination and delayed submission)
antecedent: Facing creative tasks that require output
Anticipating scenarios of strict evaluation or comparison
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white thinking equating imperfection with failure, and Fear of negative evaluation
target_behavior.function: Escaping Anxiety and the shame of being evaluated
target_behavior.consequence: Academics and Professional performance impaired, further deepening Self-doubt

antecedent: Ruminates at night about rejection experiences and self-reproach
Long-term daytime stress and negative self-evaluation
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized 'should' rules and persistent negative rumination maintain physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: Relieves guilt through self-depletion / self-punishment (a short-term illusory sense of control)
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental energy decline, affecting emotion regulation and study/creative efficiency
